question.text: Net Exposure in NIFTY Options after offsetting (Put premium Rs. 85.5 lakh − Call premium Rs. 49.5 lakh)?

explanation.text: The Logic: Net exposure after offsetting opposite positions equals the put premium minus the call premium: Rs. 85,50,000 − Rs. 49,50,000 = Rs. 36,00,000, which matches the source's offsetting illustration for NIFTY50 options. The Trap: The other options show unadjusted gross values (the put premium alone, the call premium alone, or their sum) rather than the net figure after offsetting. Note: Based on Series-XIX-B workbook p.282, which gives NIFTY50 put options at Rs. 85,50,000, NIFTY50 call options at Rs. 49,50,000, and net exposure after offsetting of Rs. 36,00,000.
